title: Answer from git history: when and why was the discount cap added
prompt:
Product wants to raise the maximum discount (MAX_DISCOUNT in tally/discounts.py) to 40%. Before anyone changes it, I need its history from this repo's git log. Write ANSWER.md in the repo root with exactly these four lines:

introduced: <full hash of the commit that first added the cap>
issue: <the issue number that commit cites>
last_value_change: <full hash of the most recent commit that changed the cap's value>
previous_value: <the value before that change, as a decimal like 0.15>

You can add a short explanation below those lines. Don't change any code or history.
